facts.text: A supplier of refined carbonite and andris spice for much of galactic history, Empress Teta was a major hub of operations for the Mining Guild, which exerted control over the planetary government.

evidence.quote: A supplier of refined carbonite and andris spice for much of galactic history, Empress Teta was a major hub of operations for the Mining Guild, which exerted control over the planetary government.

facts.text: By the reign of the Galactic Empire, the world was alternatively known as Cinnagar, the name of its capital city.

evidence.quote: By the reign of the Galactic Empire, the world was alternatively known as Cinnagar, the name of its capital city.

facts.text: Empress Teta was a city-world that was considered the gateway to the Deep Core.

evidence.quote: Empress Teta was a city-world that was considered the gateway to the Deep Core.

facts.text: Orbited by the moon Atale, it was connected to Coruscant via the Koros Trunk Line and to Prakith via the Byss Run.

evidence.quote: Orbited by the moon Atale, it was connected to Coruscant via the Koros Trunk Line and to Prakith via the Byss Run.

facts.text: When the Galactic Empire came to power, Empress Teta became a key checkpoint for the Imperial Deep Core Security Zone, causing Imperial Intelligence to restrict non-essential traffic by intentionally making the system's astrogation charts confusing and inconsistent.

evidence.quote: When the Galactic Empire came to power, Empress Teta became a key checkpoint for the Imperial Deep Core Security Zone, causing Imperial Intelligence to restrict non-essential traffic by intentionally making the system's astrogation charts confusing and inconsistent.

facts.text: Empress Teta's cityscape was known as Cinnagar, the planet's capital which grew over millennia to cover the whole surface.

evidence.quote: Empress Teta's cityscape was known as Cinnagar, the planet's capital which grew over millennia to cover the whole surface.

facts.text: Under the city-scape existed carbonite and andris spice mines operated by the Mining Guild.

evidence.quote: Under the city-scape existed carbonite and andris spice mines operated by the Mining Guild.

facts.text: Though most of the system's andris production occurred off-world by the age of the Empire, the guild retained much of its administrative infrastructure in Cinnagar.

evidence.quote: Though most of the system's andris production occurred off-world by the age of the Empire, the guild retained much of its administrative infrastructure in Cinnagar.

facts.text: In antiquity, Empress Teta was home to extensive mining operations of andris and carbonite, which allowed the world to become an early stronghold of the Mining Guild.

evidence.quote: In antiquity, Empress Teta was home to extensive mining operations of andris and carbonite, which allowed the world to become an early stronghold of the Mining Guild.

facts.text: Though the andris mines on Empress Teta were abandoned once they ran dry, the Mining Guild continued to assert control over the world and eventually usurped the power of the ruling Keto family in all but name.

evidence.quote: Though the andris mines on Empress Teta were abandoned once they ran dry, the Mining Guild continued to assert control over the world and eventually usurped the power of the ruling Keto family in all but name.

facts.text: The guild's affiliation with the Confederacy of Independent Systems caused Empress Teta to side against the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, while loyalist nobles fled to Coruscant.

evidence.quote: The guild's affiliation with the Confederacy of Independent Systems caused Empress Teta to side against the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, while loyalist nobles fled to Coruscant.

facts.text: After the war ended with a Separatist defeat, the newly-formed Galactic Empire installed these nobles in positions of power, such as planetary bureaucrats or Mining Guild administrators.

evidence.quote: After the war ended with a Separatist defeat, the newly-formed Galactic Empire installed these nobles in positions of power, such as planetary bureaucrats or Mining Guild administrators.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was ruled by Emperor Alor Keto, though he was largely an ineffectual puppet of the Mining Guild.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was ruled by Emperor Alor Keto, though he was largely an ineffectual puppet of the Mining Guild.

facts.text: Already a major supplier for the Imperial Military, Empress Teta assumed increased strategic importance for the Empire as its location restricted access to the Deep Core Security Zone, where the Empire tested experimental technologies such as Interdictors.

evidence.quote: Already a major supplier for the Imperial Military, Empress Teta assumed increased strategic importance for the Empire as its location restricted access to the Deep Core Security Zone, where the Empire tested experimental technologies such as Interdictors.

facts.text: The extent to which the capital Cinnagar covered the world also caused many to refer to the world itself as Cinnagar, even in official documentation—a source of confusion at times.

evidence.quote: The extent to which the capital Cinnagar covered the world also caused many to refer to the world itself as Cinnagar, even in official documentation—a source of confusion at times.

facts.text: A major supplier of refined carbonite, the planet was a major hub of operations for the Mining Guild.

evidence.quote: A major supplier of refined carbonite, the planet was a major hub of operations for the Mining Guild.

facts.text: Empress Teta was a city-planet located in the outer shell of the galaxy's Deep Core, at the terminus of the Koros Trunk Line directly galactic south of Coruscant.

evidence.quote: Empress Teta was a city-planet located in the outer shell of the galaxy's Deep Core, at the terminus of the Koros Trunk Line directly galactic south of Coruscant.

facts.text: With over half its landmass covered by its capital Cinnagar, and vast reserves of carbonite that made the backbone of Empress Teta's economy, the planet was the center of galactic civilization in the Deep Core.

evidence.quote: With over half its landmass covered by its capital Cinnagar, and vast reserves of carbonite that made the backbone of Empress Teta's economy, the planet was the center of galactic civilization in the Deep Core.

facts.text: While officially a monarchy, the Mining Guild held the true power on the planet in the post-Unification era as the stores of carbonite on the planet gave them the advantage of setting galactic prices on the valuable commodity.

evidence.quote: While officially a monarchy, the Mining Guild held the true power on the planet in the post-Unification era as the stores of carbonite on the planet gave them the advantage of setting galactic prices on the valuable commodity.

facts.text: Due to the reliance on carbonite economically, mines dotted the surface of the planet and the cityscape, and had at one point threatened to completely shatter the environment of the world.

evidence.quote: Due to the reliance on carbonite economically, mines dotted the surface of the planet and the cityscape, and had at one point threatened to completely shatter the environment of the world.

facts.text: The discovery of the valuable substance on the other six worlds of the Empress Teta system enabled the Mining Guild to do much of its business offworld, allowing the nonurbanized areas of Empress Teta to avoid the environmental damage that befell the other worlds of the system.

evidence.quote: The discovery of the valuable substance on the other six worlds of the Empress Teta system enabled the Mining Guild to do much of its business offworld, allowing the nonurbanized areas of Empress Teta to avoid the environmental damage that befell the other worlds of the system.

facts.text: Where the city had not grown, some areas of wildlife remained, including forests and plains.

evidence.quote: Where the city had not grown, some areas of wildlife remained, including forests and plains.

facts.text: An authorized supplier of the spice, andris' primary function was as a cure for hibernation sickness, a side effect that befell ancient colonists that had been frozen in carbonite on sleeper ships once they were woke from their slumber.

evidence.quote: An authorized supplier of the spice, andris' primary function was as a cure for hibernation sickness, a side effect that befell ancient colonists that had been frozen in carbonite on sleeper ships once they were woke from their slumber.

facts.text: Like most controlled substances, the criminal element on the planet had discovered a way to make andris spice a powerful stimulant and sought ways to sell it on the black market.

evidence.quote: Like most controlled substances, the criminal element on the planet had discovered a way to make andris spice a powerful stimulant and sought ways to sell it on the black market.

facts.text: This criminal problem was an issue until the rise of the Galactic Empire, which stamped out much of the black market dealers.

evidence.quote: This criminal problem was an issue until the rise of the Galactic Empire, which stamped out much of the black market dealers.

facts.text: Traffic in the planet's skylanes and orbit was controlled centrally from the Cinnagar Space Traffic Control tower.

evidence.quote: Traffic in the planet's skylanes and orbit was controlled centrally from the Cinnagar Space Traffic Control tower.

facts.text: Cinnagar Control directed ships leaving orbit, arranged for repairs to returning vessels, and kept wanted vessels and those taking unauthorized action in line with its own defense force of Koros Spaceworks interceptors.
entities: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1

evidence.quote: Cinnagar Control directed ships leaving orbit, arranged for repairs to returning vessels, and kept wanted vessels and those taking unauthorized action in line with its own defense force of Koros Spaceworks interceptors.

facts.text: Nobles on the planet traced their ancestry back to the legendary Empress Teta herself; though some historians questioned her actual existence by the rise of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: Nobles on the planet traced their ancestry back to the legendary Empress Teta herself; though some historians questioned her actual existence by the rise of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Lesser nobles possessed a share of the Mining Guild's activity in the system, allowing them to amass great fortunes.

evidence.quote: Lesser nobles possessed a share of the Mining Guild's activity in the system, allowing them to amass great fortunes.

facts.text: The Revan Mythologies credited the colony ships from Tython with the discovery of Koros Major.

evidence.quote: The Revan Mythologies credited the colony ships from Tython with the discovery of Koros Major.

facts.text: These first settlers discovered massive deposits of carbonite ore on all seven inhabitable planets of the system, and the Korosians made a further discovery that space travelers could be frozen in carbonite in a state of suspended animation, allowing them to survive the long trips between stars.

evidence.quote: These first settlers discovered massive deposits of carbonite ore on all seven inhabitable planets of the system, and the Korosians made a further discovery that space travelers could be frozen in carbonite in a state of suspended animation, allowing them to survive the long trips between stars.

facts.text: The planet of Koros Major became a boomworld, and the new Mining Guild made it one of their strongholds.

evidence.quote: The planet of Koros Major became a boomworld, and the new Mining Guild made it one of their strongholds.

facts.text: With the invention of the hyperdrive, hyperspace scouts carved out the hyperspace route known as the Koros Trunk Line or "Carbonite Pipeline", running from Koros to Coruscant, shortly before the foundation of the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY.

evidence.quote: With the invention of the hyperdrive, hyperspace scouts carved out the hyperspace route known as the Koros Trunk Line or "Carbonite Pipeline", running from Koros to Coruscant, shortly before the foundation of the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY.

facts.text: With the foundation of the Republic and its subsequent growth, the route saw trillions of tons of carbonite move out to Coruscant while explorers moved in to Koros to take advantage of the unexplored Deep Core.

evidence.quote: With the foundation of the Republic and its subsequent growth, the route saw trillions of tons of carbonite move out to Coruscant while explorers moved in to Koros to take advantage of the unexplored Deep Core.

facts.text: As the outpost on the only major route into the Deep Core, Koros became the primary stop in the region and the largest settlement on the new Deep Core frontier, and almost overnight turned into a booming city-planet.

evidence.quote: As the outpost on the only major route into the Deep Core, Koros became the primary stop in the region and the largest settlement on the new Deep Core frontier, and almost overnight turned into a booming city-planet.

facts.text: The Hyperspace Navigator's Guild established their headquarters on Koros, launching explorations to find new ways through the densely packed stars of the Deep Core.

evidence.quote: The Hyperspace Navigator's Guild established their headquarters on Koros, launching explorations to find new ways through the densely packed stars of the Deep Core.

facts.text: While the carbonite mines of Koros were nominally under the control of Coruscant, illegal claimants attempted to take advantage of the world's resources.

evidence.quote: While the carbonite mines of Koros were nominally under the control of Coruscant, illegal claimants attempted to take advantage of the world's resources.

facts.text: Supreme Chancellor Fattum of the Republic granted ownership of the system to the Teta aristocrats in a scandal that ultimately ended his administration, but the system's new nobility ignored the smuggling of carbonite.

evidence.quote: Supreme Chancellor Fattum of the Republic granted ownership of the system to the Teta aristocrats in a scandal that ultimately ended his administration, but the system's new nobility ignored the smuggling of carbonite.

facts.text: In 5010 BBY, however, Empress Teta took the throne and launched the Unification Wars, an effort to eliminate all non-government mining settlements and unite the seven worlds of the Koros system under a mutual defense and trade alliance.

evidence.quote: In 5010 BBY, however, Empress Teta took the throne and launched the Unification Wars, an effort to eliminate all non-government mining settlements and unite the seven worlds of the Koros system under a mutual defense and trade alliance.

facts.text: In 5000 BBY, the Jedi Odan-Urr was dispatched to Koros to aid Teta and her Jedi advisor Memit Nadill in ending the war, and his knowledge and application of battle meditation enabled Teta to take Kirrek with minimal casualties and seize victory in the war.

evidence.quote: In 5000 BBY, the Jedi Odan-Urr was dispatched to Koros to aid Teta and her Jedi advisor Memit Nadill in ending the war, and his knowledge and application of battle meditation enabled Teta to take Kirrek with minimal casualties and seize victory in the war.

facts.text: Odan-Urr was assigned on a long-term basis to the Koros system to ensure the security of Teta's realm in the Republic's interest.

evidence.quote: Odan-Urr was assigned on a long-term basis to the Koros system to ensure the security of Teta's realm in the Republic's interest.

facts.text: The detention facilities of Koros, meanwhile, were used to hold accused war criminals awaiting trial.

evidence.quote: The detention facilities of Koros, meanwhile, were used to hold accused war criminals awaiting trial.

facts.text: When Kahorr sent assassins after them, the Daragons stole their own ship, Starbreaker 12, out of hock and, fighting their way past the planet's defense forces, set off to find one big route to settle all their debts.

evidence.quote: When Kahorr sent assassins after them, the Daragons stole their own ship, Starbreaker 12, out of hock and, fighting their way past the planet's defense forces, set off to find one big route to settle all their debts.

facts.text: Shortly after, Odan-Urr had a vision of danger from the Sith Lords, exiled from the Republic millennia before, which he presented to Teta.

evidence.quote: Shortly after, Odan-Urr had a vision of danger from the Sith Lords, exiled from the Republic millennia before, which he presented to Teta.

facts.text: The Daragons, meanwhile, had found a new route, and more; after a blind leap into hyperspace, they arrived on Korriban, tombworld of the Sith Empire and the exiled Sith Lords.

evidence.quote: The Daragons, meanwhile, had found a new route, and more; after a blind leap into hyperspace, they arrived on Korriban, tombworld of the Sith Empire and the exiled Sith Lords.

facts.text: Naga Sadow, Dark Lord of the Sith, turned Gav to his side and allowed Jori to escape in Starbreaker 12, tracking her back into the heart of the Republic.

evidence.quote: Naga Sadow, Dark Lord of the Sith, turned Gav to his side and allowed Jori to escape in Starbreaker 12, tracking her back into the heart of the Republic.

facts.text: Jori, escaping from the prison colony on Ronika, returned to Koros and infiltrated Teta's palace to speak with the Empress.

evidence.quote: Jori, escaping from the prison colony on Ronika, returned to Koros and infiltrated Teta's palace to speak with the Empress.

facts.text: Her statements about the Sith confirmed what Teta had heard from the Jedi; the Empress summoned Koros' defenses and prepared to strengthen the system as a bastion against the coming invasion.

evidence.quote: Her statements about the Sith confirmed what Teta had heard from the Jedi; the Empress summoned Koros' defenses and prepared to strengthen the system as a bastion against the coming invasion.

facts.text: Meanwhile, having finally mustered his forces, Naga Sadow followed the Daragons' route back to the star Primus Goluud, where his forces split to launch a series of simultaneous attacks on Republic worlds, initiating the Great Hyperspace War.
entities: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2
Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, having finally mustered his forces, Naga Sadow followed the Daragons' route back to the star Primus Goluud, where his forces split to launch a series of simultaneous attacks on Republic worlds, initiating the Great Hyperspace War.

facts.text: The Tetan fleet launched from Koros Major to engage the Sith forces—under the command of Gav Daragon—in orbit above.

evidence.quote: The Tetan fleet launched from Koros Major to engage the Sith forces—under the command of Gav Daragon—in orbit above.

facts.text: As the Sith lay siege to the city below, Gav headed to the surface in an attempt to disengage the Korosian defenses and force a near-bloodless victory.

evidence.quote: As the Sith lay siege to the city below, Gav headed to the surface in an attempt to disengage the Korosian defenses and force a near-bloodless victory.

facts.text: With the Sith offense collapsing on every front, Jori and the Tetan fleet followed, driving Sadow back to the Sith Empire, and ultimately into exile on Yavin 4.

evidence.quote: With the Sith offense collapsing on every front, Jori and the Tetan fleet followed, driving Sadow back to the Sith Empire, and ultimately into exile on Yavin 4.

facts.text: Odan-Urr salvaged the remnants of the Sith fleet in orbit of Koros for artifacts, taking them with him to build a library on Ossus.

evidence.quote: Odan-Urr salvaged the remnants of the Sith fleet in orbit of Koros for artifacts, taking them with him to build a library on Ossus.

facts.text: Koros became the capital of a small empire in the Deep Core, and the carbonite mines brought wealth to all of the world's inhabitants and turned the planet into a prosperous and peaceful model world that much of the Deep Core attempted to emulate.

evidence.quote: Koros became the capital of a small empire in the Deep Core, and the carbonite mines brought wealth to all of the world's inhabitants and turned the planet into a prosperous and peaceful model world that much of the Deep Core attempted to emulate.

facts.text: Koros finally eclipsed its rival Kaikielius, driving the latter planet into ruin in an attempt to compete.

evidence.quote: Koros finally eclipsed its rival Kaikielius, driving the latter planet into ruin in an attempt to compete.

facts.text: Teta's descendants continued to rule the system, but over the next millennium they were increasingly forced to share power with the commercial interests that controlled the carbonite mines.

evidence.quote: Teta's descendants continued to rule the system, but over the next millennium they were increasingly forced to share power with the commercial interests that controlled the carbonite mines.

facts.text: The Krath response to resistance was quick; Aleema suffocated a group of insurrectionists on Empress Teta who planned to attack the palace.

evidence.quote: The Krath response to resistance was quick; Aleema suffocated a group of insurrectionists on Empress Teta who planned to attack the palace.

facts.text: Despite a joint task force of Republic soldiers and Jedi assault the Krath warship, Aleema Keto's powerful sorcery was able to destroy moral within the opposition forces.

evidence.quote: Despite a joint task force of Republic soldiers and Jedi assault the Krath warship, Aleema Keto's powerful sorcery was able to destroy moral within the opposition forces.

facts.text: The Republic, led by Captain Orley Vanicus and Jedi Ulic Qel-Droma aboard the Reliance I, was too late to prevent the planet's fall and were forced to retreat.

evidence.quote: The Republic, led by Captain Orley Vanicus and Jedi Ulic Qel-Droma aboard the Reliance I, was too late to prevent the planet's fall and were forced to retreat.

evidence.quote: Holed up in the Iron Citadel, Satal and Aleema Keto held mass execution in public squares to inspire loyalty through fear.

evidence.quote: Shortly thereafter, the planet was visited by fallen Jedi Exar Kun, who desired to destroy those who could potentially impede his own Empire.
